//! A whole file under `tests/`, which is skipped by its path before anything
//! in it is walked. Its functions branch so that scoring it would be visible.

fn band(n: i64) -> &'static str {
    if n < 0 {
        "negative"
    } else if n == 0 {
        "zero"
    } else {
        "positive"
    }
}

#[test]
fn bands_are_named() {
    for n in [-1, 0, 1] {
        assert!(!band(n).is_empty());
    }
}
